title: AgentOS TUI Oriented System
source: TUI oriented AgentOS request; Agent Runtime + Ecosystem final audit
objective: Promote TUI from demo/projection surface into the primary operator console for AgentOS while preserving AgentCore, SecurityExecution and aom ownership boundaries.
entry_criteria: Agent Runtime + Ecosystem Chain final audit is completed.
AgentCore durable run APIs exist and remain authoritative.
SecurityExecutionEngine remains the only side-effect path.
aom install/stage remains inert and activation remains runtime-mediated.
Baseline TUI gates remain local-only and do not depend on network, external LLM, Firecracker or host package manager.

waves.name: TUI OS Contract Freeze
waves.purpose: Freeze TUI-oriented AgentOS ownership, command grammar, state model and safety gates before implementation.
exit_criteria: TUI is defined as operator surface, not runtime owner.
TUI command grammar rejects shell-like execution.
TUI evidence and replay gates are defined.

waves.name: Durable AgentCore TUI Bridge
waves.purpose: Connect TUI to real AgentCore durable run operations instead of demo sessions.
exit_criteria: TUI can submit, plan, advance, approve, deny, suspend and recover real AgentCore runs.
RunStore and AuditJournal remain source of truth.
TUI controller is thin and typed.

waves.name: Operator Console Views
waves.purpose: Build production TUI projections for dashboard, run detail, approvals, audit, recovery and support.
exit_criteria: Operator can inspect current OS/runtime status from TUI.
Run, audit, rollback, recovery and support views are deterministic and redacted.
TUI text snapshots are testable.

waves.name: Interactive Command Loop
waves.purpose: Replace demo prompt with a safe TUI command loop and deterministic event/update model.
exit_criteria: TUI accepts typed operator actions, not shell fragments.
Exact approval and denial flows are first-class.
Refresh/recovery behavior is deterministic and restart-safe.

waves.name: Ecosystem And Production Operations In TUI
waves.purpose: Expose aom lifecycle, support bundle export and production runbook operations through TUI without bypassing runtime boundaries.
exit_criteria: TUI can explain ecosystem registry/staged/active/blocked state.
TUI can trigger safe support bundle export.
Production runbooks can consume TUI projections.

waves.name: Boot And Distro Packaging
waves.purpose: Make TUI the default packaged operator console while preserving headless and CI smoke paths.
exit_criteria: Rootfs config declares TUI console defaults.
QEMU smoke can prove TUI-ready boot markers.
Headless mode remains available for automation.

waves.name: TUI Safety Replay And Final Audit
waves.purpose: Add TUI replay, adversarial command tests, release gating and final promotion audit.
exit_criteria: TUI replay is release-gated.
Command injection, approval mutation and secret leak fixtures fail closed.
Final audit decides whether AgentOS can claim TUI-oriented Alpha status.
